dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical linear reduction in width from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Medium-light grey median intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency, uniform distribution of dark-grey pixel clusters across the entire visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient between the darker mottled clusters and the lighter grey baseline canvas.
